messages:
rachel: FYI customers reporting wrong completions (garbled tokens) from hosted models in us-east-1. Error rate ~9% and a few high-severity tickets opened.
paul: Looking at model-cache layer. Seeing checksum mismatches on several shard files after the nightly compaction job.
nora: Paging infra oncall. @oncall-bot please create incident.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5622 created and assigned to infra-oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5622
paul: Hotfix plan: 1) disable compaction job 2) restart cache workers to force re-fetch of shards 3) route traffic away from affected hosts.
rachel: Routing policy updated: smart-routing moved ~70% traffic to other regions within 2m.
paul: Disabled compaction: infra flag compaction.enabled=false applied.
paul: Restarting cache workers now: ```systemctl restart cache-worker@{1..6}```
paul: Logs show re-downloads succeeding; shards validated via checksum.
nora: Status page please.
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5622 - "Partial degradation: model cache corruption in US-EAST-1. Mitigation in progress."
cs-lead: Notifying affected enterprise customers and routing all new support tickets to priority queue.
rachel: Error rates falling to ~0.6%. Keeping compaction disabled until next maintenance.
paul: Follow-ups: 1) add integrity check to compaction job 2) avoid in-place compaction over live shards 3) add alert for cache shard checksum failures
nora: Tickets created: INF-8080, INF-8081, INF-8082
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5622 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
rachel: Thanks team — will publish postmortem and customer timeline in ~2h.
